symbols.read: Price has pushed further to 746.35, extending the grind toward the 758.57 pivot and keeping the bearish breakdown stalled, though the 4H stays bearish and the combined signal has flipped from HOLD to SELL, hardening conviction. The 1H trend remains down and the 758.57 short is still MISSED, so 758.57 stays the invalidation line with hard stop 775.89 and target 721.33. Bias stays bearish and is now firmer than the previous read, but the BULLISH regime tag still conflicts with the bearish structure. Invalidation is unchanged: a reclaim of 758.57.
